items.problem: CS0103: The name 'App' does not exist — SDK-sample 'namespace SDKTemplate' files reference App, but the WinUI 3 scaffold puts App in the project root namespace.
items.evidence: session-log.txt L2360-2364; App.xaml.cs 'namespace RelativeInclinometer;' vs MainPage.xaml.cs/SampleConfiguration.cs 'namespace SDKTemplate'. Skill grep for 'SDKTemplate'/'CS0103' = 0 hits.
items.root_cause: Structural namespace split between scaffold-generated App (root namespace) and verbatim-copied Windows-universal-samples sources (SDKTemplate).
items.change: Added a 'CS0103: The name App does not exist (SDKTemplate namespace split)' entry to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Common build errors after the namespace rewrite', with two reconciliation options (add 'using <RootNamespace>;' per file, or move scaffold App into 'namespace SDKTemplate').
items.expected_effect: Agent applies the namespace reconciliation up front (or fixes it in one pass on first build error) on every SDK-sample migration.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run of any SDKTemplate-based scenario, the CS0103 'App' errors are resolved in a single edit (or avoided) rather than debugged from scratch; build reaches green without a stall on 'App'.
items.tier_justification: Tier 1/2 rejected: the bootstrap does not own App generation (App comes from 'dotnet new winui' before Initialize-UwpMigration runs), and auto-rewriting namespaces across copied sources is risky/over-broad. The fix is knowledge the agent needs at build-error time, which is exactly what MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Common build errors' delivers and Get-MigrationPattern.ps1 surfaces.

items.problem: MainPage.xaml x:Bind DataTemplate failed (WMC0909/WMC1111/WMC1509) — cascade from the CS0103 code-behind failure aborting MarkupCompilePass.
items.evidence: session-log.txt L2370-2373; fixed turn 32 by switching to Text={Binding Title}.
items.root_cause: x:Bind DataTemplate x:DataType could not resolve because a prior code-behind compile error aborted the markup compile pass; existing x:Bind section did not cover DataTemplate resolution or the cascade.
items.change: Extended MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md '### x:Bind and compiled bindings' with a paragraph on DataTemplate x:DataType failures: fix code-behind first (cascade), then correct xmlns:local or fall back to classic {Binding}.
items.expected_effect: Agent stops chasing XAML type-resolution errors that clear once code-behind compiles, and knows the {Binding} fallback.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run, the agent fixes code-behind before touching the DataTemplate, and WMC0909/WMC1111 clear without a separate debug loop.
items.tier_justification: Prose-only sharpening of an existing section; no script/template can convey compile-ordering reasoning.

deferred_to_human: Eval-side: WinUI 3 PNG screenshot capture returns blank on the virtual display (DirectComposition limitation); scoring already falls back to the UIA tree — belongs to the parity-check harness, not the migration skill.

Tier-0/harness idea: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 could optionally detect a 'namespace SDKTemplate' sample + root-namespace scaffold App and auto-reconcile, but that is a bootstrap/harness enhancement to evaluate carefully before auto-applying.
